visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short dark hair wearing a bright red t-shirt stands in a modern kitchen with red cabinets. He gestures toward the camera with a playful, energetic facial expression, squinting his eyes and smiling widely. (2) A woman with dark hair tied back in a bun, wearing a dark green hooded sweatshirt, is shown in close-up and medium shots in the kitchen. She is vigorously mixing glutinous rice in a large stainless steel pot using her bare hand. (3) The scene transitions to a series of close-up insert shots of a black ceramic pot. Fresh ingredients including sliced Napa cabbage, various brown mushrooms, red dates, and strips of light-colored tofu are neatly arranged inside the pot. (4) Two children, a boy in a navy blue shirt and a girl in a black and white striped long-sleeved shirt, stand at the kitchen counter. They hold a grey spatula together and pretend to stir the contents of the black pot as steam rises significantly from it. (5) A sudden burst of white steam erupts from the pot, causing the boy to jump back in shock with a wide-eyed expression. The kitchen background is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting and various appliances are visible on the counters. (6) A man with a shaved head wearing a green and white striped long-sleeved shirt leans into the kitchen frame. He smiles and gestures while talking to the woman, who is stirring a large wok. (7) The camera pans over a dining table decorated with a festive red and white tablecloth covered in Chinese "Fu" (blessing) characters. Red plastic plates with gold trim and red paper cups are arranged for a holiday dinner. (8) The family is shown sitting around the table, eating. Close-up shots feature the various finished dishes: black bean curd tofu, golden-brown glutinous rice, and the mushroom-rich "Buddha jumped over the wall" soup. (9) A hand pours golden-colored Apple Sidra soda from a yellow and red can into a red paper cup. The children are seen drinking and smiling, with the boy holding his cup up for a toast. (10) The final sequence shows the family members laughing and interacting at the table. The children clap their hands joyfully while the woman eats soup from a red bowl, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied expression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family's Lunar New Year's Eve (Xiao Nian Ye) celebration, focusing on the mother's first attempt at cooking traditional dishes like glutinous rice and 'Buddha jumped over the wall'. It highlights the joyous atmosphere of family preparation and the children's enthusiastic participation and reaction to the meal.
